author: MiniWarGaming
description:
We're excited to introduce the newest terrain set, the Outposts of Perdition, designed for seamless visual compatibility with our existing Ruins and Depths of Perdition lines. These 3d printed pieces can connect, allowing you to build incredible structures like bunkers, towers, and helipads, perfect for creating your own research station or even a survival shelter. This set makes it easy to build amazing looking tabletop layouts quickly, saving you time and effort while enhancing your wargaming experience.

Get yours here:  https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/miniwargaming/the-outposts-of-perdition?ref=youtube
title: More 3D Printed Terrain!  The Outposts of Perdition
